summary: Only about one in ten workers belongs to a union, with local government and teaching far above that.
realLife: BLS reported a 10.0 percent union membership rate for 2025, 32.9 percent in the public sector and 5.9 percent in the private sector.
inGame: job record with employer sector and position; needs: union membership as a worker field

turns.summary: A teacher or city worker is simply a member.
A store clerk has never met a union member.
A worker is covered by a contract without joining.
